US in talks with AI firms on model standards, report says

The United States is reportedly nearing an agreement with major artificial intelligence companies, including OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic, to establish voluntary standards for AI models. This development comes as OpenAI reportedly delayed the public launch of GPT-5.6 at the US government's request.
